name: orange-red-lonely-silhouette
image_vibe: Solitary, cinematic, high-contrast, orange-red gradient minimalism
image_purpose: Create an atmospheric menswear/editorial silhouette portrait.

prompt.project_info: A cinematic minimal portrait of a solitary adult man in an intense orange-to-red gradient environment.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult man standing alone with a calm introspective posture and a clean readable silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Symmetrical composition, glossy reflective floor, solitary central figure, smooth gradient from intense orange to deep red, and generous minimal negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong silhouette lighting, deep shadow contrast, controlled warm rim, and quiet dramatic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Cinematic portrait orientation, realistic glossy floor reflection, high-detail photorealism, controlled gradient, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a cinematic minimal portrait of a solitary original adult man standing in an intense orange-to-red gradient environment. Use strong silhouette lighting, deep shadow contrast, a reflective glossy floor, symmetrical composition, minimal negative space, controlled warm rim light, and photorealistic cinematic rendering with no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, distorted silhouette, warped reflection, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No external reference is required for this text-derived minimalist concept. Preserve one original adult male, solitary silhouette, orange-to-red gradient, glossy floor, symmetry, and deep shadow contrast; the exact identity and studio details may vary.
